info.title: KotiSpot Real Estate API
info.description: API for property listings, favourites, inquiries, contact messages, moderation, verification, and price estimation.

url.description: JPEG/PNG/WebP data URL or http(s) image link

messageId.name: messageId
messageId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the contact message

applicationId.name: applicationId
applicationId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the verification application

post.summary: Request a 6-digit login code by email
Verify a login code and receive a JWT

200.description: List of users with permitted actions

post.summary: Create a property (verified seller/agent or admin)

get.summary: Get properties owned by the current user

200.description: Nearby places (empty list with unavailable=true when the service is down)

get.summary: Get a publicly visible property by ID

patch.summary: Update a property (owner, verified seller/agent or admin)

delete.summary: Delete a property (owner, verified seller/agent or admin)

post.summary: Report a public listing (non-admin users, once per listing)

403.description: Admins cannot report; owners cannot report their own listing

409.description: Listing already reported by this user

Get inquiries I sent that have been answered

Admin removes a contact message from their notifications
